Common Questions

Frequently Asked
Questions

The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidy is available for residential rooftop grid-connected solar systems. You must be a homeowner, the system must be connected to the DISCOM grid (net metering), and you must apply through the official PM Surya Ghar portal. Commercial and industrial properties are not eligible.
With Gujarat’s excellent solar irradiance and government subsidies, residential systems typically achieve payback in 4–6 years. Commercial and industrial systems typically see 3–5 year payback due to higher electricity rates. We provide a site-specific projection before you commit.
Net metering allows surplus solar energy to flow back into the DISCOM grid and be credited to your bill. Xeron handles the complete application process with Gujarat DISCOMs (PGVCL, MGVCL, UGVCL, DGVCL) — from technical drawings to inspection coordination to meter installation.
Solar systems require minimal maintenance. Panel cleaning every 3–6 months is the primary need, costing roughly ₹1,000–2,000/year for residential. Commercial O&M contracts include remote SCADA monitoring, quarterly preventive maintenance, and emergency response.
We use only Tier-1 solar panels with a 25-year linear performance warranty (min 80% output at year 25) and 10-year product warranty. Inverters carry 5–10 year warranties with extended options. All warranties are manufacturer-backed — no grey-market products.
Residential systems (3–10 kW) are installed in 2–5 days. Commercial (20–100 kW) in 7–14 days. Large industrial plants (100 kW–1 MW) in 3–6 weeks. Full timeline from inquiry to system live — including DISCOM approval and net metering — is typically 30–45 days for residential.
